figurative_meaning_en: To become accustomed or proficient at something
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গাড়ি চালানোয় হাত আসা হয়েছে।
এই কাজে তার হাত পুরোপুরি আসে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He has gotten the hang of driving the car.
She hasn't quite gotten the hang of this task yet.
note: The idiom metaphorically refers to a skill 'coming to hand' like a tool becoming easy to use.
